rules.title: Security Deposit - Service Member Higher Security with Return Requirement
rules.requirement: On or after April 1, 2025, if a landlord charges a service member a higher than standard security due to credit history, credit score, housing history, or other tenant-related factors, the landlord must provide written notice explaining the higher amount on or before the lease is signed, and the additional security must be returned after no more than six months of residency if the tenant is not in arrears for any rent due, with the return date included in the lease agreement.

On or after April 1, 2025, if a landlord or its agent charges a service member who rents residential property in which the service member will reside a higher than standard or advertised security pursuant to paragraph (1) due to the credit history, credit score, housing history, or other factor related to the tenant, the landlord shall provide the tenant with a written statement, on or before the date the lease is signed, of the amount of the higher security and an explanation why the higher security amount is being charged. The additional amount of security shall be returned to the tenant after no more than six months of residency if the tenant
is not in arrears for any rent due during that period. The date for return of the additional amount of security shall be included in the lease agreement.

rules.coverage_conditions: Service member renting residential property; charged higher than standard or advertised security; effective on or after April 1, 2025
